competences.description: Attacks all enemies to block them from receiving beneficial effects for 1 turn with a 50% chance. This attack ignores all effects that resist death.
Increases the Ancient Guardian's Attack Power and Critical Rate by 20%. Stuns the enemy with the fewest stacks of [Heat] for 1 turn and grants 1 additional stack of [Heat]. [Automatic Effect]

Attacks all enemies to grant Oblivion for 2 turns with a 50% chance, then additionally attacks up to 3 more times according to the number of [Heat] stacks granted on the target. This attack ignores all effects that resist death.

Attacks all enemies 3 times with an attack that will always have an attribute advantage. The first hit prevents them from removing harmful effects for 2 turns, the second hit increases their chance of landing a Glancing Hit for 2 turns, and the third hit decreases their Defense for 2 turns. The damage dealt increases in proportion to the number of [Heat] stacks granted on the target, and enemies with 10 or more [Heat] stacks are stunned for 1 turn.
